Just thought I'd share my rant about why I hate DEF. If you aren't familiar, all diesel engines since around 2007 have been required to reduce emissions by the US government. One way to do this with a diesel particulate filter and exhaust gas regenerators. More recently, this has been achieved with a system which injects diesel exhaust fluid (which is basically distilled water and urea) into the exhaust to neutralize NOx emissions. The idea is a good one, and it doesn't affect performance (unlike the DPF and EGR) when working correctly. However, the implementation has been asinine.

Here are some issues: * Every diesel engine sold with few exceptions are required to take DEF. They all shut down or limp mode if there's no DEF in the tank. Trucks, tractors, generators, all diesel engines. * If you run out of DEF while driving--which is very possible as it uses it WHILE DRIVING--your vehicle goes into limp mode. It may not go above 1200 RPMs in some cases, and may restrict power even further beyond this. Some trucks limit your speed to 25MPH until you refill your DEF. Think about why this would be a problem on an interstate, or in the middle of the desert. * You may trick some sensors by adding water (distilled preferably). Other sensors, however, will detect that there is no urea and keep you in limp mode. Then you have to drain the water out and refill with real DEF. * If your sensor goes bad and it tells the computer in your truck that there's no DEF, you can drown your truck in an ocean of DEF and it will stay in limp mode. * If your DEF system gets plugged up, or malfunctions in any way, your engine is in limp mode.

Why this is bad: * Obviously, these issues are bad for everyday drivers because it adds the wholly unnecessary inconvenience of adding another thing to your engine to keep it running--something that isn't actually required for smooth operation of your engine. If you don't, you'll literally break down but only because the computer is telling the engine to do so. * If you cannot access DEF, you're left with a useless engine and/or truck. * This is all to appease environmentalist nuts, and does little to actually curb pollution, as diesel engines in the US which would be affected by this--new ones, that is--are a negligible polluter. All the old diesel engines will still run just as dirty, and all the ones in China and India wont be affected.

This is taking ownership of your vehicle and/or engine completely away from you. You don't get to tell the engine when to run, the engine gets to tell you when it wants to run. I understand an engine shutting itself off in cases of overheating, loss of oil pressure, low fuel, or anything else that will actually compromise the engine's ability to run smoothly / prevent damage, but turning itself off because it cant inject piss water into the tailpipe is fucking ludicrous.

What happens when, even though you've stocked DEF for thousands of miles but your DEF level or quality sensor goes out and you cant get a new one, or the part is 100 miles or a day's shipping away? Do you stop working your ranch, running your generators, driving your heavy equipment, etc?
